annotations.title: Collect guest photos via QR code

description: Use this when the user wants their guests to upload their own photos from their phones into one shared event album (e.g. via a QR code at a wedding or party). Returns how QR photo collection works, what to check and practical tips, plus one option by the same developer (Guest Pictures). Do not use when the user just wants a photo booth (use open_photo_booth).
name: collect_guest_photos_info
title: Collect guest photos via QR code
